description.en: The domain name. You can call the [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d\_0) operation to obtain the domain name.

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，取值：

- **zh**：中文

- **en**：英文

默认为**zh**
description.en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

Default: **zh**

description.zh:
备注，长度限制50个字符，只可包含中英文数字以及 . 、_、- 

为空时删除原有备注
description.en:
The remarks. The remarks can be up to 50 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

Delete the original remarks when it is empty.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-dns-cache-domain-remark --lang en --domain-name example.com --remark test --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns UpdateDnsCacheDomainRemark --region cn-hangzhou --DomainName 'example.com' --Lang en --Remark test
